name: UI i18n
purpose: Internationalization and localization system providing translation provider, hooks, and multi-language support
short_description: i18n translation provider with React hooks and HOC support
long_description:
@waysnx/ui-i18n provides a complete internationalization system for React applications.

Key Capabilities:
- React Context-based translation provider
- useTranslation hook for functional components
- HOC for class component support
- Multi-language message sets (ES, FR, AR)
- Component-specific message definitions
- Runtime language switching
- Default messages with fallback support
- Library-wide consistent translation model

provider.name: TranslationProvider
provider.usage: Wrap application tree with TranslationProvider to enable translation system

hooks.description: Hook to access translations in functional components
hooks.signature: useTranslation(): { t: (key: string) => string; language: string }

hoc.description: HOC to inject translations into class components
